description.summary: draw the window switcher in an external client

protocol.description:
The compositor owns the window switcher session: the key chord, the order of the windows, the selection and the commit when the modifier is released. This protocol lets one trusted client draw that session.
The compositor offers this global only to the client it launched as the renderer. It keeps its own on-screen display as the fallback: if the renderer has not acknowledged a session in time, or is gone, the compositor draws the session itself. The renderer can never commit, focus or raise a window; it may only ask to move the selection.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made.

interface.name: zlabwc_window_switcher_renderer_v1

description.summary: the window switcher, for the client that draws it

interface.description: Every event carries the session it belongs to. A session begins with session_start, then one window event per window in the compositor's order, then windows_done and selected. The window list is sent again (window events, then windows_done) whenever it changes during the session. A session ends with ended; after that, requests naming it are ignored.

entry.name: current_workspace
entry.summary: on the workspace the person is on

entry.name: focused
entry.summary: the window that had focus when the session began

entry.name: cancelled
entry.summary: Escape, a lock, or no windows left

event.name: window

description.summary: one window of the session, in order

event.description: Strings come from the clients that own the windows and must be treated as untrusted text.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: stable id of the window while it exists

arg.name: idle_ms
arg.summary: milliseconds since the window last had focus, 0 if never known

event.name: key

description.summary: a key the compositor did not use during the session

event.description: Only sent for keys the compositor does not consume in a session (for example letters, digits, space). utf8 is the text the key produces, or empty.

request.name: ack

description.summary: the renderer is drawing this session

request.description: Sent once the renderer has drawn the session. Until it arrives the compositor may draw its own on-screen display; a late ack after the compositor has fallen back is ignored for that session.

request.name: select
request.description: Ignored unless the session is current and the id is in its list. Never commits: the compositor still commits on the modifier release.

event.name: thumbnail

description.summary: a picture of one window, as asked for with capture

event.description: The window's content as the compositor last drew it, scaled down to fit the size capture asked for, keeping its aspect ratio. fd is a sealed memory file of stride * height bytes: ARGB8888 (little-endian B, G, R, A), alpha premultiplied, rows top to bottom. The client maps or reads it and closes it; it is never written again. Only windows in the session's own list are ever sent, and only to the renderer.

request.name: capture

description.summary: ask for a picture of one window

request.description: Ignored unless the session is current and the id is in its list. The answer is a thumbnail event, or nothing if the window has nothing drawn yet or the compositor is answering too many requests. max_width and max_height are clamped to 16..1024.
